commentary.text: 90+11' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+11' Charles Pickel (Espanyol) is yellow-carded.
90+9' Castrin (Sevilla) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
90+9' Fernando Calero (Espanyol) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Javier Alberola ignores the protests.
90+9' The referee blows his whistle, Espanyol are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' The referee shows the yellow card to Akor Adams (Sevilla).
90+1' 2 - 1 Akor Adams (Sevilla) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot inside the right post.
90+1' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
83' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Exposito is replaced by Pol Lozano (Espanyol).
83' Substitution. Kike Garcia (Espanyol) has come on for Roberto Fernandez Jaen.

82' 1 - 1 Castrin (Sevilla) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Marko Dmitrovic is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
75' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to substitute Ruben Vargas and he is replaced by Akor Adams (Sevilla).
75' Here comes a substitution. Ramon Terrats is given a rest as he is replaced by Jofre (Espanyol).
75' Substitution. Jose Salinas (Espanyol) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Carlos Romero walks off.
73' A yellow card for a tackle by Djibril Sow (Sevilla). Javier Alberola doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
73' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) gets booked for the first time in this match.
73' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
70' Sevilla quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
68' The corner from Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) is intercepted by Odysseas Vlachodimos.

67' Exposito (Espanyol) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Espanyol.
66' Today's match ends for Ruben Sanchez who will be replaced by Charles Pickel (Espanyol).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) replaces Jose Angel Carmona.
64' Luis Garcia Plaza decides to make a substitution. Gabriel Suazo will be replaced by Oso (Sevilla).
63' Sevilla are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
61' Javier Alberola shows the yellow card to Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) for a heavy challenge.
59' Sevilla are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
58' Here comes a substitution. Djibril Sow (Sevilla) is brought on as a substitute for Lucien Agoume.

56' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Roberto Fernandez Jaen. The score is now 0:1.

55' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by Odysseas Vlachodimos!
55' Sevilla seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
54' Exposito (Espanyol) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
53' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
52' Espanyol enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
51' The Sevilla players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
48' The goal by Sevilla won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
48' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Sevilla players aren’t happy.
46' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) collects a rebound and hits it precisely into the bottom left corner.
46' Luis Garcia Plaza makes a switch. Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) is coming on in place of Isaac Romero at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Marko Dmitrovic (Espanyol) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' The game is interrupted now, Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
44' The resulting corner from Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) comes to nothing.
44' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. Sevilla get a corner.

42' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) tries his luck with a long-range effort after receiving a precise pass. It goes to the roof of the net, but Marko Dmitrovic has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
42' Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
37' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic comes off his line to gather the ball.

34' Exposito (Espanyol) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
33' Fernando Calero (Espanyol) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' The referee blows his whistle as Isaac Romero (Sevilla) was too aggressive in his challenge.
31' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 58:42.
29' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for an infringement.
26' Javier Alberola shows a yellow card to Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) for a tough tackle.
25' Exposito (Espanyol) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

25' Exposito (Espanyol) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the top right corner. Odysseas Vlachodimos is alert and denies him with a nice save. The referee signals a corner kick to Espanyol.
23' Exposito (Espanyol) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
22' Exposito (Espanyol) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
21' Great teamplay by Espanyol as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
20' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Tyrhys Dolan, but Odysseas Vlachodimos displays great awareness to stop him.
19' The Espanyol players are exchanging some short passes.
18' Neal Maupay (Sevilla) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
16' Espanyol will take a free kick from near the half-way line.
15' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) will deliver the corner kick.

14' Sevilla players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Espanyol.
14' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sevilla.
13' Javier Alberola interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Exposito (Espanyol). Sevilla are awarded a free kick.
12' Marko Dmitrovic displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
10' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Ruben Vargas (Sevilla).
9' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Sevilla for a penalty. Play continues.
6' Sevilla control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
5' Good work from Espanyol as they win a corner.
4' Exposito (Espanyol) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. It will be a corner kick for Espanyol.
2' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Sevilla was in an offside position.
